name: P09 — the field camera: DQV framing, follow, orbit, ease-behind, lead, modes, cutscene, clean occluder fade

steps.note: THE OPENING FRAME. A DQV field shot is a lens FOLLOWING a child: the boy is ~20% of frame height (144px at 720p), his feet ~79% down it, the horizon ~17% down it, over the ground angle the map asked for (26 degrees, as in docs/approved/field-opening.png). Measured through the live projection matrix, not eyeballed.

steps.msg: the boy READS: 18-23% of frame height (DQV PS2 scale)
his feet sit low in the frame, the land he is walking into above him
a real band of sky over the shot
DQV pitch band
a following boom, not a survey from the hill behind
DQV field of view
the fade pass found the map's occluders

steps.note: THE MAP OWNS THE FRAMING: the mode presets never overwrite it. Into a house and out again comes back to THIS map's pitch / boom / lens, because cameraMode re-reads the live map's camera block every time.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify((() => { const g = () => { const c = __DQ.state().field.camera; return {pitch: c.pitch, dist: c.distTarget, fov: c.fov, hero: c.composed && c.composed.hero}; }; const before = g(); __DQ.cameraMode('interior', true); const interior = g(); __DQ.cameraMode('field', true); const after = g(); window.__p09map = {before, interior, after, mapPitch: 26}; return window.__p09map; })())

steps.msg: cameraMode returns to the LIVE map's framing, not a preset
the ground angle is the one the map asked for (26 degrees)

steps.note: SPRING FOLLOW + LEAD: walk up the lane; the camera eases behind him and leads the walk

EASE-BEHIND without fighting: hold right for two and a half seconds and MEASURE it — the camera swings round behind him while his path stays straight (the swing goes into the camera, never into the walk frame)

steps.eval: (async () => { const {Field} = await import('/src/world/field.js'); const orbit0 = __DQ.cameraOrbit(); const pts = []; let maxDrift = 0; __DQ.hold('right', 2600); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const c = __DQ.state().field.camera; const p = Field.world().player.p; maxDrift = Math.max(maxDrift, Math.abs(c.drift)); pts.push([+p.x.toFixed(2), +p.z.toFixed(2)]); } const a = pts[1], b = pts[pts.length - 1]; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; let bend = 0; for (const q of pts.slice(1)) bend = Math.max(bend, Math.abs((q[0] - a[0]) * dz - (q[1] - a[1]) * dx) / L); window.__p09 = {orbit0, orbit1: __DQ.cameraOrbit(), walk: __DQ.state().field.camera.walk, maxDrift: +maxDrift.toFixed(1), path: +L.toFixed(2), bend: +bend.toFixed(3)}; return JSON.stringify(window.__p09); })()
